subject: PV energy return and storage cost in the literature

finding.claim: PV EROI results vary with the system boundary: module-and-inverter studies omit costs that broader point-of-use studies include, so the field reports no single universal PV EROI. Raugei, Leccisi and Fthenakis (2020) report that a 100 MW PV system with 60 MW lithium-manganese-oxide storage had a 7-30% longer energy-payback time than PV alone, depending on storage duration.

method: Reading of the cited sources on 2026-09-05, carried into this record on 2026-10-30 from the September 19 note.
